feeds.title: New Healthy Body Blog
feeds.description: Covers tips and advice about how you can improve your physical and mental health and well-being. The mission of New Healthy Body is to provide a safe, comfortable and relaxed environment where customers can improve their health and wellbeing.

feeds.title: Rebecca Morris Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Learn about all things Pilates with articles and updates from Rebecca Morris Pilates. Rebecca is a Level 3 Mat Pilates teacher in the Benson, Oxfordshire area offering mixed-ability classes. She was first introduced to Pilates after the birth of her second child after being diagnosed with Symphysis Pubis Disorder. Pilates helped her to overcome the issues and she continued to attend classes enjoying both the physical and mental benefits that it brings.

feeds.title: VFJ Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the VFJ Pilates blog. My name is Victoria and I am the main writer for this blog. I blog about many things relating to the business, current events as well as things that interest me. Find posts about online training, online fitness classes, being a Pilates class instructor, my family life, my hobbies, my thoughts, feelings and much more.

feeds.title: Tempo 301 Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news insights and information about Tempo 301, our classes, trainers, programs guides and more! Tempo Pilates is a comprehensive Reformer Pilates method performed to invigorating music. By adding the 301 tempo philosophy to a series of controlled and precise mind-body movements - each guided with breath - our classes are given a pace that creates flow, encouraging centering and concentration.

feeds.title: Victoria Rose Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Diving into the history, the principles and the way in which Pilates can help YOU improve your wellbeing to live a life full of energy, flow and power! I'm Victoria and I'm a 32 year old, Norwich born movement lover with an obsession on the human body! My passion is deeply rooted in understanding, appreciating and celebrating how marvelous our bodies are daily!

feeds.title: Pilates Scotland Blog
feeds.description: Pilates Scotland Blog informs you about Pilates sessions and news about their classes. Visit the blog to know about their schedule. Born in 2020, Pilates Scotland online introduces an exciting range of services that provides their members with unlimited access to an extensive library of mat-based Pilates classes with new workouts being added each week.

feeds.title: JPilates Blog
feeds.description: The JPilates blog is about Pilates teacher training and education. Visit the blog to know more about Pilates and other interesting information about JPilates. JPilates Teacher Training was founded by Joanne Cobbe, one of the Pilates industry's leading educators. Our highly qualified and experienced team are dedicated to supporting you during your training to become a Pilates Instructor and also throughout your career.

feeds.title: Elite Pilates Teacher Training Blog
feeds.description: Our Pilates & Yoga health blogs will help you on the road to becoming a Pilates teacher trainer in the UK. Elite Pilates Teacher Training is the Best Pilates Teacher Training in UK. We help aspiring Yoga & Pilates teachers become qualified instructors.

feeds.title: Everybody Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Pilates is simply an exercise system designed to stretch, strengthen and balance the body, focusing on improving posture, core strength and flexibility. Learn more about Pilates here. Everybody Pilates was Co-founded by Amy Kellow, who is a 2nd Generation Master Trainer. Amy brings her passion for Classical Pilates from studying it in her own background and working with the very best teachers in the field.

feeds.title: The Vitality Method Blog
feeds.description: Discover new and important articles on all things health and fitness. I cover topics including self-care and recipes. Vitality Method is a place for community - where you get strong, & radiantly healthy from the inside out, and leave floating. The classes are a great place to meet like-minded friends that support your healthy journey (and have a cuppa after class!)

feeds.title: The Pilates Pod Blog
feeds.description: The Pilates Pod Blog tells you how you can fix various ailments with the help of Pilates. Manage pain and restore your health with Pilates. The Pilates Pod was founded in 2011 by Michelle Smith as a centre for excellence in Pilates. It is the first dedicated Pilates studio in Hitchin, Hertfordshire, and one of only a handful of Classical Studios in the UK, offering the full authentic Pilates experience.

feeds.title: All Active Pilates & Physio Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our blog were we share useful information about what we do and how we help people move better and feel better. All Active Pilates & Physio was founded in 2014 and offers Physiotherapy, Pilates, Reformer, Yoga, Barre, Bike fit, Sports massage, and Nordic walking. They are helping people move better and feel better.

feeds.title: VI Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the classical Pilates blog where you can find inspiration for workouts, wellness tips, and advice to help you on your Pilates journey. At VI Pilates, we stay true to the original works of Joseph Pilates and honour the integrity of the Joseph Pilates method. Our founder Sarah Janes, is a comprehensively certified classical Pilates instructor.

feeds.title: Lauren Hilton Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Learn how Pilates could benefit your wellbeing and become a lifestyle with the Lauren Hilton Pilates Blog. Lauren Hilton Pilates is a mindful movement Pilates studio nestled in the heart of Shrewsbury, offering a vibrant mix of Pilates classes, one-to-one tuition, and on-demand videos to nourish your body and mind with movement that feels good.

feeds.title: Power Pilates UK Blog
feeds.description: Power Pilates UK Blog explains about Dynamic Pilates, gives an introduction to their trainers and much more information. Power Pilates UK provides Dynamic Reformer Pilates, an innovative, results driven class that will tone, sculpt and strengthen your body in ways you never thought possible.

feeds.title: Pilates Blogger UK Blog
feeds.description: The Pilates Blogger UK explains the many ways that Pilates can help you. Pilates Blogger UK is one of the UK's leading experts in common Orthopedic conditions, caused by and including pregnancy, sports injuries, JHS (Joint Hypermobility Disorder), Tennis Elbow, back, knee, hip, wrist and neck pains. The Hope Centre offers Pilates, Massage, , injury specific and chronic pain treatments.

feeds.title: Pilates Live Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Pilates Live blog to learn all about improving your strength with Pilates. Pilates Live is run by me - Vicky. The site is all about making Pilates accessible. I aim to create a similar, progressive experience that you may have by joining a local class - but in your own environment and accessible at any time.

feeds.title: Complete Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Read and search our blog for articles, research and videos on Pilates and how it can help you. At Complete Pilates we strive to offer the highest quality, physiotherapist led Pilates which is open to all. At Complete Pilates, all our instructors have a strong understanding of pathology, pain management and biomechanics and understand how each movement can translate into function.

feeds.title: Newcastle Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Get information about Pilates from experienced physiotherapist.

feeds.title: Pawprints Pilates & A Piece of Cake Blog
feeds.description: Pawprints Pilates & A Piece of Cake Blog teaches you about Pilates and how it can help your mind and body. Trudy has been doing Pilates since 2004. In 2018 she started Pawprints, Pilates and a Piece of Cake with the help or, more often, hindrance of her wonderful dogs. Her work combines three of her passions in life; dogs, Pilates and cake.

feeds.title: Experience Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Experience Pilates blog will help with Mental Health Awareness, Pilates and Pain Management. I'm Cath Hopkinson and I'm a L4 Pilates Therapist (Mat & Apparatus) and also a Pilates specialist and creator of many result-driven Pilates programmes and we are one of the area's longest-running Pilates schools.

feeds.title: Promise Pilates Blog
feeds.description: The Promise Pilates Blog provides information on the importance of physical fitness and regular exercise. I'm Kirsty Green, owner of Promise Pilates. I have been a level 3 qualified Personal Trainer and Sports Massage Therapist since 2001. I decided to diversify my career and in 2015 became a qualified level 3 mat based Pilates Teacher and level 3 GP Exercise Referral Coach.

feeds.title: Berrylands Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Keep updated on new classes and other news with the Berrylands Pilates blog post. Berrylands Pilates is run by Aga Waszkielis, a qualified Pilates instructor and Sport Rehabilitator. She trained with the Australian Physiotherapy and Pilates Institute (APPI) to teach Pilates for ante-natal, post-natal general Pilates, strength & balance classes.

feeds.title: PhysioPilates Academy Blog
feeds.description: Amanda Savage, experienced physiotherapist and Pilates instructor writes the PhysioPilates blog & makes videos to help you get more from your Pilates classes and improve your physiotherapy outcomes. Amanda is a specialist pelvic health physiotherapist as well as an experienced Pilates teacher, author and mum.

feeds.title: BBodySmart Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Read The Latest News, Updates and Helpful Content From BbodySmart Pilates Studio in Bury. Our aim is to help improve your mood, fitness and energy regardless of your age, physicality or fitness ability. Pilates is the ultimate in core training and here at Bbodysmart we offer cost effective, small group sessions as well as personal training reformer sessions in our beautiful, bespoke reformer Pilates studio.

feeds.title: The Garage Studio Blog
feeds.description: The Garage Studio Blog believes in happy body, happy you. Get health and movement tips, accessible info to include in your day to help you feel healthier and happier. The Garage Studio is transformational, supportive and professional. We provide classes for Pilates, yoga, relaxation, Mum/Baby mat classes, Reformer Pilates and Workshops and Retreats.

feeds.title: Bridge Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Pilates is my passion. It's a privilege to teach and share in my clients individual and successful journeys to better health and wellbeing. Bridge Pilates provides the perfect way to explore the balance of mind and body fitness.

feeds.title: Chilli Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Our mission at Chilli Pilates is to make you feel fitter, healthier an happier! Learn more about our pilates classes and approach to health and fitness. Visit the Chilli Pilates Blog to read our articles, get advice and useful tips.

feeds.title: Marguerite Pilates
feeds.description: Marguerite Galizia is a dance artist and Pilates teacher. She trained at London Contemporary Dance School and has a BA(Hons) in Contemporary Dance and an MA in Choreography. Since graduating in 2007 Marguerite has built up a wide network of clients and classes in the North West and Central London areas. An eye for detail and a genuine love for movement combine into the rich, detailed approach that characterises her teaching.

feeds.title: Pilates Foundation
feeds.description: The Pilates Foundation brings together qualified Pilates teachers who are passionate about providing the highest standards of training and practice.

feeds.title: Rachel Lawrence Pilates Blog
feeds.description: The Girl With The Pilates Mat is a blog by Rachel Lawrence who is mindfully moving towards a happy now. Check out the website to know about Healthy living advice through Pilates, dance, fitness, food, fashion. I'm Rachel and I'll be your personal guide to getting the most from Pilates. I trained in California with two of the world's leading Pilates Practitioners, Rael Isacowitz and Karen Clippinger, so that I could bring that expertise back to the UK.

feeds.title: Reactivate Pilates Blog
feeds.description: Reactivate Pilates is providing you with all the Pilates knowledge, tips and tricks you'll need to become a more confident and fearless mover. At Reactivate Pilates our aim is to create a safe space where you can not only feel confident to explore movement but it leaves you feeling stronger, leaner and with mental clarity.
